# Living in the Sacred Presence of the Divine Mother

### Swami Chidananda Giri • Yogoda Satsanga Society of India

Loving blessings. Swami Chidananda Giri teaches us the beautiful, practical art of living in the sacred presence of the Divine Mother. It is not enough to find peace during meditation; we must carry that silent temple of peace throughout all our activities.

### Maintaining the Sacred Thread of Prayer

Let every activity be an offering of love. Whether you are working, eating, or walking, think of the Divine Mother as your constant companion. This keeps your consciousness elevated and prevents the ego from taking root.

### Transforming Our Daily Thoughts

Your mind is like a garden. If you plant thoughts of worry and desire, you will harvest restlessness. But if you constantly replace those weeds with silent whispers to God, you will transform your entire life.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Continuous Prayer:** Keep a quiet, loving dialogue going with the Divine Mother during your office work.
* **Work as Worship:** Offer the fruits of all actions to the Lord in your heart.
* **Gentle Speech:** Cultivate soft, encouraging, and patient speech with everyone you encounter.
* **Night Reflection:** Before sleep, analyze your daily behavior and rest in Her comforting presence.

Jai Guru! Jai Ma!
rawText: We must learn to carry the portable temple of peace with us wherever we go. Offer all actions to the Divine Mother as cooperative worship to keep your thoughts elevated...
